newsitem.title: USA: General Re up after Q4 earnings.
newsitem.headline: General Re up after Q4 earnings.

text.p: Shares of General Re Corp rose over two percent on Friday after the company reported fourth quarter earnings that beat analysts' expectations.
General Re reported operating earnings of $2.83 a share compared with the First Call consensus of $2.76.
Sanford C. Bernstein analyst Weston Hicks said the earnings topped his expectations because of improved profit margins in the international property-casualty business.
Hicks said he raised his 1997 estimate by $0.10 to $12 a share and raised his 1998 estimate by $0.45 to $13.35 a share.
General Re rose 4-1/8 to 160-3/4 in afternoon trading.
However, Hicks said he maintains his neutral rating on the stock.
Hicks said he expects top line growth to remain constrained by intense competition in the industry.
Instead of cutting prices to grow market share, Hicks said he expects General Re to continue to distribute excess capital shareholders in the form of dividends and share repurchases.
